pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
The day you left, you didn't say anything
I thought it would be for a while
I just thought we were a little distant
But in time, you don't come back

[Verse 2]
Sit by the window and look at our pictures
Your smiling face keeps blurring
Maybe you're crying like me
That's why I stay up all night

[Pre-Chorus]
It would've been enough to say a word
Why did we get so far back then
If I had caught you more
I wonder if we've changed

[Chorus]
I think of you at night
My longing under the light builds up
look at the door in fear of returning
Tears are falling down again

[Verse 3]
I'll put you in a glass of alcohol today
I'm quietly calling out my name
Only your scent remains in the empty room
I can't forget it no matter how much I erase it

[Chorus]
I feel lonelier at night
The day is full of you
I think he'll come back. I want to believe him
Only the cold wind is passing by

[Bridge]
a light that can be seen out of the window
I don't know if it's your house, I'm asking
"It's going to be okay"
My heart is still there

[Final Chorus]
At night, I miss you again
I'm waiting for you again today
Please open the door again someday
Just once
Give me a hug
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.

pkg.youtubeDescription:
🌙 Still There opens on the quiet shock of a goodbye that never came, when distance felt temporary and time refused to bring anyone home.

💭 The heart of this song lives in late-night windows, blurred photos, whispered names over a drink, and the stubborn hope that the door might still open once more.

✨ As a POP Original Song, it keeps the original story’s ache while wrapping every line in soft, modern pop warmth and clear emotional honesty.

💬 Starlights, if this track found you in a quiet hour, tell us in the comments who or what is still sitting in that same place for you.

#AIArtistNoa #OriginalSong #POP
